basis: Static source derivation; not a live schema dump or database test

nonliteral_plugin_table_conversion.empty_database: approve_proc_msgs exists and already uses utf8mb4_unicode_ci; ten plugin-owned approval tables are absent and must not be fabricated

server_semantics.behavior: Explicit DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP preserves source MariaDB 10.7 implicit first non-null TIMESTAMP default, avoiding a different result on newer MariaDB defaults
MariaDB JSON alias supplies LONGTEXT utf8mb4_bin storage and JSON_VALID constraints. Metadata records declared JSON type; DB reflection may return LONGTEXT and generated CHECK metadata.
InnoDB creates a supporting index for the source foreign key; represented explicitly in checked-in DDL and metadata.
Signed BIGINT stored generated expression -`msg_id`, retained with cursor index order from migration217.
TIMESTAMP(3) retained; all other migration timestamps default to precision zero.

integration_obligations.requirement: Real system-functions application provisioning, existing config preservation, no fake installed seed state

recommended_checks_not_run: Apply schema.sql then schema_seed.sql in an isolated empty pinned MariaDB database owned by this new app
Reflect information_schema and compare all 77 tables / 716 columns / 258 indexes including PRIMARY / 8 foreign keys against metadata, accounting for MariaDB JSON aliases and generated constraints
Confirm 5 settings rows, one completed zero-history backfill row, zero users/business rows and no app installation claim
Exercise nullable/default/unique/FK cascade behavior, millisecond timestamps, FULLTEXT and stored cursor expression with rollback-only disposable data
runnable_check_not_run: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE') = 77 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()) = 716 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settings) = 5 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM web_socket_dialog_msg_attachment_backfills WHERE status = 'completed' AND before_msg_id = 0 AND last_msg_id = 0) = 1 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS new_install_schema_baseline;
runnable_check_scope: Run immediately after source schema/seed, before parent-owned security/infrastructure tables are added; this baseline is not an exhaustive schema comparison
